triples.tail_surface: The length of the bearing, next to and supporting the propeller, is to be not less than four times the required tail-shaft diameter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承长度不小于四倍尾轴直径
triples.evidence_text: The length of the bearing, next to and supporting the propeller, is to be not less than four times the required tail-shaft diameter.

triples.head_surface: bearings of rubber, reinforced resins, or plastic materials
triples.head_canonical_zh: 橡胶、增强树脂或塑料轴承
triples.tail_surface: the length of the bearing... may be less than four times, but not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter, provided the bearing design is being substantiated by experimental tests
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承长度可小于四倍但不小于两倍尾轴直径（需经试验验证）
triples.evidence_text: However, for bearings of rubber, reinforced resins, or plastic materials, the length of the bearing, next to and supporting the propeller, may be less than four times, but not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter, provided the bearing design is being substantiated by experimental tests to the satisfaction of ABS.

triples.head_surface: Synthetic materials for application as water-lubricated stern tube bearings
triples.head_canonical_zh: 水润滑尾管轴承合成材料
triples.tail_surface: are to be of approved type
triples.evidence_text: Synthetic materials for application as water-lubricated stern tube bearings are to be of approved type.

triples.tail_surface: The length of white-metal-lined, oil-lubricated propeller-end bearings fitted with an approved oil-seal gland is to be not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 带认可油封的白合金油润滑螺旋桨端轴承长度不小于两倍尾轴直径
triples.evidence_text: The length of white-metal-lined, oil-lubricated propeller-end bearings fitted with an approved oil-seal gland is to be not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter.

triples.head_canonical_zh: 白合金油润滑螺旋桨端轴承
triples.tail_surface: nominal bearing pressure is not more than 0.80 N/mm2
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 名义轴承压力不超过0.80 N/mm²
triples.evidence_text: The length of the bearing may be reduced provided the nominal bearing pressure is not more than 0.80 N/mm2 (0.0815 kgf/mm2, 116 psi) as determined by static bearing reaction calculation taking into account shaft and propeller weight which is deemed to be exerted solely on the aft bearing, divided by the projected area of the bearing surface.

triples.tail_surface: The length of synthetic rubber, reinforced resin or plastic oil lubricated propeller end bearings fitted with an approved oil-seal gland is to be not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 带认可油封的合成橡胶、增强树脂或塑料油润滑螺旋桨端轴承长度不小于两倍尾轴直径
triples.evidence_text: The length of synthetic rubber, reinforced resin or plastic oil lubricated propeller end bearings fitted with an approved oil-seal gland is to be not less than two times the required tail shaft diameter.

triples.head_surface: synthetic rubber, reinforced resin or plastic oil lubricated propeller end bearings
triples.head_canonical_zh: 合成橡胶、增强树脂或塑料油润滑螺旋桨端轴承
triples.tail_surface: nominal bearing pressure is not more than 0.60 N/mm2
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 名义轴承压力不超过0.60 N/mm²
triples.evidence_text: The length of bearing may be reduced provided the nominal bearing pressure is not more than 0.60 N/mm2 (0.0611 kgf/mm2, 87 psi) as determined by static bearing reaction calculation taking into account shaft and propeller weight which is deemed to be exerted solely on the aft bearing, divided by the projected area of the bearing surface.

triples.head_surface: oil-lubricated cast iron or bronze bearings
triples.head_canonical_zh: 油润滑铸铁或青铜轴承
triples.tail_surface: The length... is to be not less than four times the required tail shaft diameter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承长度不小于四倍尾轴直径
triples.evidence_text: The length of oil-lubricated cast iron or bronze bearings which are fitted with an approved oil-seal gland is to be not less than four times the required tail shaft diameter.

triples.head_surface: Stern tube bearing oil lubricating system
triples.tail_surface: An arrangement for readily obtaining accurate oil samples is to be provided
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 提供便于获取准确油样的装置
triples.evidence_text: An arrangement for readily obtaining accurate oil samples is to be provided.

triples.head_surface: Stern tube bearing oil lubricating system
triples.tail_surface: sampling point is to be taken from the lowest point in the oil lubricating system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 从润滑油系统最低点取样
triples.evidence_text: The sampling point is to be taken from the lowest point in the oil lubricating system, as far as practicable.

triples.tail_surface: arrangements are to be such as to permit the effective removal of contaminants from the oil lubricating system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置应允许有效去除润滑油系统中的污染物
triples.evidence_text: Also, the arrangements are to be such as to permit the effective removal of contaminants from the oil lubricating system.

triples.tail_surface: The length of grease-lubricated bearings, next to and supporting the propeller, is to be not less than four times the diameter of the required tail shaft diameter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 脂润滑轴承长度不小于四倍尾轴直径
triples.evidence_text: The length of grease-lubricated bearings, next to and supporting the propeller, is to be not less than four times the diameter of the required tail shaft diameter.
